commands.name: search-places
commands.summary: Geocode a place name or address with Nominatim, the search engine openstreetmap.org uses. Returns OSM type/id, coordinates and display name.

commands.name: get-element
commands.summary: Get the detail page of an OSM node, way or relation: name, current version, last editor, changeset, edit comment and tags (as text).

commands.name: get-element-history
commands.summary: List every version of an OSM node, way or relation, with version number, editor, timestamp, changeset and comment.

commands.name: get-element-full
commands.summary: Get raw OSM data as JSON for a way or relation together with all its member nodes (coordinates, tags, versions, editors).

commands.name: export-map-data
commands.summary: Download all raw OSM data (nodes, ways, relations) in a small bounding box as JSON. This is what the Export button returns.

commands.name: get-route
commands.summary: Get turn-by-turn directions between two coordinates with the OSRM engine (FOSSGIS) for car, bike or foot. Returns distance in meters and duration in seconds.

commands.name: get-route-valhalla
commands.summary: Get directions with the Valhalla engine (FOSSGIS). Returns human-readable maneuvers, length and time.

commands.name: list-area-changesets
commands.summary: List recent changesets (edit sessions) in a bounding box, newest first. Use --before for older ones.

commands.name: list-user-changesets
commands.summary: List a user's changesets (edits), newest first. Use --before for older ones.

commands.name: get-user
commands.summary: Get a mapper's public profile: edit count, mapper-since date, last edit date and description.

commands.name: get-user-contributions
commands.summary: Get a user's contribution count for the last year (from the activity heatmap).

commands.name: list-diary-entries
commands.summary: List the latest user diary entries from all languages, newest first. Use --before for older ones.

commands.name: list-diary-entries-by-language
commands.summary: List the latest diary entries written in one language (e.g. en, de, fr), newest first.

commands.name: get-diary-entry
commands.summary: Read one diary entry: title, author, date, full text, location and the comment discussion.

commands.name: list-communities
commands.summary: List the official OpenStreetMap Local Chapters (country or regional organisations) with their websites.

next: clify openstreetmap search-places --q "Central Park, New York" --api_limit "5"
